description:
About the role

At NetBox Labs, we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises.

We're hiring a Head of FP&A to own how NetBox Labs plans, allocates capital, and measures performance. Reporting to the CFO, you'll run the company's planning and forecasting engine, be the finance partner to the executive team, and build the FP&A team that scales with us. This is a leadership role. You'll take on complex, ambiguous problems with no clean answer, own the finance relationship with every executive and budget owner, and lead the team that does the work.

What you'll do

Own the planning engine

  • Own annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasts, scenario planning, and the long-range plan end to end; set the calendar, the guidance, and the bar for accuracy

  • Own the integrated three-statement operating model, with driver-based forecasts for ARR, bookings, GAAP revenue, collections, burn, and runway

  • Run the budget-owner operating cadence: monthly budget-vs-actual reviews with each VP, clear spend guardrails, and accountability for variances

Steer capital allocation

  • Manage the day to day finance relationship with each executive and budget owner; be their first call on where to invest

  • Take on the company's hardest cross-functional business questions, often undefined and with imperfect data; frame them, bring a point of view, recommend tradeoffs, and make the case for them

  • Partner with People team on headcount planning and workforce cost

Own the financial narrative

  • Own company KPIs (ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC payback, capital efficiency, Rule of 40, margin, productivity) and benchmark them against best-in-class enterprise software peers

  • Own financial data quality, metrics, and the narrative in management and investor reporting

Build the function

  • Make AI and automation the default way the team works, scaling output without scaling headcount linearly

  • Lead and grow the FP&A team: hire, set goals, coach, and develop

  • Drive the FP&A systems roadmap

  • Partner with the Controller on close, flux, and forecast hygiene so actuals and plan tell one story

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital, including 4+ years in high-growth enterprise software (Series B through IPO-track)

  • You've been the senior FP&A leader at a venture-backed company and owned company-level planning, cash forecasting, and the three-statement model

  • You've hired, developed, and led an FP&A team, and built process and systems from scratch, not just inherited them

  • Deep fluency in SaaS metrics, enterprise value drivers, subscription unit economics, GTM capacity and productivity, and sales compensation design

  • Board- and investor-ready: you've built and presented Board materials and supported a priced equity round or diligence process

  • GAAP literacy: revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, and the timing gap between bookings, revenue, and cash in high-ASP enterprise deals

  • You own executive relationships end to end: VPs seek you out, trust your numbers, and accept a "no" or "not yet" from you

  • Strong problem solving in ambiguity: you break down complex problems with no clear owner or clean data, land on a recommendation, and balance precision with speed without over-engineering

  • Hands-on with AI and automation in your own workflow; advanced spreadsheet modeling; SQL or BI fluency is a plus

  • Nice to have: open-source or developer/infrastructure software experience; EPM implementation experience

Our stack

  • Financial planning & analysis: Spreadsheets

  • General Ledger: QuickBooks Online

  • Billing & AR: Tabs

  • CRM: HubSpot

  • AP & corporate cards: Ramp

  • Payroll: Justworks, Deel

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
